Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring approval before adding fluoride to public water systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the fluoridation of public water systems; addinga new section to chapter 43.20 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that it is in thepublic interest that before the fluoridation of a public water system,the customers of the public water system or the elected local publicwater system governing body should make the final decision on theaddition of fluoride to the public water system.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The addition of fluoridation compounds to water provided by publicwater systems not adding fluoridation compounds as of the effectivedate of this section shall be permitted only upon an affirmative voteof: (1) The public water system's customers; or p. 1 HB 1646 (2) The public water system's elected local governing body directlyresponsible to the department of health for utility operations.
